Re: Formal appeal of denial for total knee replacement  
CPT 27447  
Reference number: POC-6A7FD5286D-45525  
Date of denial notice: August 3, 2026

To the Cigna Appeals Unit:

I am appealing Cigna’s denial of prior authorization for total knee replacement, CPT 27447. The denial states that the submitted records did not document an adequate trial of conservative treatment. The clinical record does document prolonged symptoms and multiple forms of provider-directed nonsurgical treatment, with inadequate relief.

The publicly available Cigna/EviCore CMM-311 knee-replacement policy identifies failure of provider-directed nonsurgical management for at least three months as a medical-necessity consideration. The policy also describes nonsurgical management as potentially including activity modification, supervised physical therapy and therapeutic exercise, prescription and nonprescription medications, assistive devices, and intra-articular injections. The following records address those requirements:

- Symptoms have progressed for nine months. The pain has not been relieved by rest.
- I used NSAIDs for six months, with inadequate relief.
- I received a corticosteroid injection on May 8, 2026. It provided only two weeks of partial relief.
- I completed 16 supervised physical-therapy visits over eight weeks, from April 20, 2026, through June 15, 2026. Therapy focused on quadriceps strengthening and range of motion, and the treatment is documented in the physical-therapy discharge note.
- The combined record therefore documents substantially more than three months of conservative treatment, including medication, injection treatment, and supervised physical therapy. These treatments failed to provide durable relief.

The records also document significant objective disease and functional impairment:

- Weight-bearing radiographs dated June 19, 2026, show bone-on-bone apposition in the medial and patellofemoral compartments, lateral joint-space narrowing, and Kellgren-Lawrence grade 4 osteoarthritis.
- Examination shows varus alignment, crepitus, effusion, and restricted motion from 5 to 100 degrees.
- I cannot climb stairs without assistance.
- Pain wakes me three to four times every night.
- The symptoms have continued despite the documented conservative-treatment trial.

The record does not show a modifiable condition that would prevent surgery. There is no active infection, no untreated substance use, BMI is 29, and I am a nonsmoker.

The denial appears to focus only on the duration or adequacy of conservative treatment and does not account for the full treatment history, the failure of each modality to provide durable relief, the grade 4 radiographic findings, or the substantial functional impairment. I request that Cigna overturn the denial and approve prior authorization for CPT 27447.

Please also provide the specific clinical review criteria and case rationale used for this determination, including the precise version of the CMM-311 policy or any additional plan-specific criteria applied to this request. Please associate all enclosed records with reference number POC-6A7FD5286D-45525.

Enclosures:

1. Copy of the August 3, 2026 adverse benefit determination  
2. Physical-therapy discharge note documenting 16 visits from April 20, 2026, through June 15, 2026  
3. Medication-treatment history documenting six months of NSAID use  
4. Record of the May 8, 2026 corticosteroid injection and its two-week partial benefit  
5. June 19, 2026 weight-bearing radiographs and imaging report  
6. Orthopedic examination and clinical summary from Duval, MD  
7. Any additional supporting medical records

Please send the appeal determination in writing.

Sincerely,

Cameron Grant
